The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] utilized a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' for sparring during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. It shared the same design as her [[Satele Shan's second double-bladed lightsaber|second double-bladed lightsaber]] that was destroyed in the [[Battle of Alderaan]].
[[File:SateleShanLightsaber-Hope.png|thumb|Shan's sparring lightsaber was designed like her saberstaffs|left]]
{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Satele Shan's sparring [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an item that could be bought from the [[Cartel Market]].
